notes.title: The first solo VRMV by Shikiri Shiishiba
notes.content:
Hop Step Sing! VRMV Vol. 7

The first solo VRMV by Shikiri Shiishiba is now available!!
This time the concept is “Let’s hold hands”.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2493710/

While on a date with Shikiri by the seaside in midsummer, you can hold her hands, take photos and create a dream-like VR music video that fans will not be able to resist. There is also a bonus ending if you make Shikiri happy and other interactions that only VR can provide. Why not create summer memories with Shikiri?

■Cast and Staff
Singer: Shikiri Shiishiba (CV: Toribe Mariko)
Character Design: Fly
Lyrics/Composer: Aira Yuki　
Arranger: Hijiri Anze
Sound Producer: Yohei Kisara(Stray Cats)
Planning & Production: Kodansha VR Lab
Production/Copyright: Kodansha

notes.title: Hop☆Summer 2nd, to be held on March 19, 2022 (Sat) 04:00(PST)!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41084327/b2fd7744b6b44089370b046642e4c245a22d445b.png

Summer on Stage ♪
Experience 360°Excitement on VR Beach！
After a year and a half, Hop Step Sing!’s VR Live is coming back with even more power as Hop☆Summer 2nd, to be held on March 19, 2022 (Sat) 04:00(PST)!

This time, the girls will be leaving Kitashinagawa and going to an island in everlasting summer to give performance from their debut song 《Kisekiteki Shining!》 to the internationally popular song 《Happy People》. The gorgeous and colorful stage with the secret ocean setting is one of the highlights!
We highly recommend you to immerse yourself with VR headset to our concert to have the best experience.
Not having any VR headset? Don’t worry! You can still join us on Nico Live, YouTube and Bilibili as we will live stream the concert at the same time.

notes.title: 『Hop Step Sing! Happy People』VRMV Photo Contest!! 📷
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=y0B-egskzqg;full][/previewyoutube].

Why don't you take your best shots of the girls at "Happy People" and post them on Twitter with "#HSS Photo Contest"?

The judges for the contest are Nina, Shikiri, and Mikasa! They will choose three winning photos, and the three winning photographers will receive a free 1-month VIVEPORT Infinity code✨.

You can edit them to be gorgeous, cute, or funny🙆don't forget to try out the zoom feature! We're waiting for their miraculous photos😍.

🎈Application period:

November 1st - November 22nd

🎈How to apply:

1. Follow @hopstepsing

2. Post your work on Twitter with "#HSSphotocontest".

VRMV "Happy People" can be purchased from

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1722140/Hop_Step_Sing/

🎈Terms and Conditions

This photo contest is for photos taken at the VRMV Happy People photo booth.
You may enter as many times as you like, but only one winning entry per person will be considered.
By following @hopstepsing and using the hashtag "#HSSphotocontest", you agree to the application guidelines and are considered to have entered this photo contest.
Please note that the photos you submit may be published on websites and social networking services operated by Kodansha VR Lab (hereinafter referred to as "the Company"). Please be aware that your photo may be posted on websites and social networking services operated by Kodansha VR Lab (hereinafter referred to as "the Company"). In such cases, the Company may include your account name and may slightly process or alter your photo for layout purposes.
Applications can be submitted worldwide.
We will use your personal information for the following purposes: to contact you about the photo contest, to provide you with photo data, and to send you your prize; we will not use your personal information for any other purposes.
